changes.title: Circle switches off
items: Things standing in front of the witch fade right away round her, over a wider, softer circle
The canopy cut-away round her is smaller again, her light reaching as far as ever
Shadows take the full colour opposite to the light they lie in
The pause page has a Low mist slider to make the mist stronger
The pause page no longer lists the circle hunt's test switches; the canopy cut-away's size slider and the Circle report stay

changes.title: Landing bake
items: A night's first minutes no longer bake every creature's art in the background, only this island's, and the art drawn ahead leaves the sound a core, so the music should stutter less as the waves land

changes.title: Audio start
items: The sound no longer thins itself out for the whole night because of a hiccup as it starts: the start's own hiccup is let pass, and after a calm minute the full mix comes back
The music is made while you're still in your room, so play starts smoother
